findings.element: Account to reconcile / Integration selects when a file is already uploaded
findings.finding: Changing the account or the integration throws away uploaded files with no confirm and no notice, but 'Use automatic retrieval' asks before it clears the same files.
findings.user_impact: A first-time user uploads the Stripe file for 'Stripe fees', then does what the reason line suggests and picks 'Stripe mzkt.by (required for Synder)', or switches back. Their file is gone without a word and has to be uploaded again (files can be up to 100MB).
findings.suggested_fix: Use the same confirm as the toggle ('Switch account? Uploaded files on this screen will be cleared.') when an account or integration change would drop uploads, and show the same 'Uploaded files cleared' notice afterwards.

evidence.action: Playwright: Integration = mzkt.by (Stripe), Account = Stripe fees, Browse (chip 'Integration_export_export.csv' appears), then Account = Stripe mzkt.by (required for Synder), then Account = Stripe fees again. Repeated with clearing + Set import methods + Assisted + Browse, then Account = Business Checking, and with Business Checking + Browse, then Integration = PayPal.
evidence.observed: No dialog fired and no cleared/removed notice appeared. The chip count was 0 after every switch, including after going back to Stripe fees. By contrast, statemap 'Use automatic retrieval (with an uploaded file)' shows the native confirm 'Switch to automatic retrieval? Uploaded files on this screen will be cleared.' and the notice 'Uploaded files cleared — using automatic retrieval.'

findings.element: 'Use automatic retrieval' link in the expanded 'Set import methods' panel
findings.finding: The expanded panel opens with both Import method selects on 'Automated (recommended)', yet the link above them says 'Use automatic retrieval' and the explanation (Synder pulls both sides, can take hours, we'll email you) is gone. The screen suggests automatic retrieval is off when it is still on.
findings.user_impact: A first-time user who opens the panel just to look can't tell whether they have left automatic mode. They may click 'Use automatic retrieval' to 'get back' when nothing changed, or pick Assisted or Manual thinking Automated no longer applies.
findings.suggested_fix: While both sides are Automated, label the link as collapsing the view (for example 'Hide import methods'), keep the hours line visible, and switch to 'Use automatic retrieval' only once a side is set to Assisted or Manual.

evidence.action: Integration = mzkt.by (Stripe), Account = Stripe mzkt.by (required for Synder), click 'Set import methods' (statemap state 'Stripe + clearing, after "Set import methods"', confirmed by Playwright).
evidence.observed: The link label changes to 'Use automatic retrieval'. The Accounting select value is 'Automated' and the Integration select value is 'Automated'. The text 'Synder pulls QuickBooks and Stripe for this period. Large pulls can take a few hours — we’ll email you when it’s ready.' no longer appears in the data section.

gaps: Retrieval failure and empty-result states are not implemented (statemap not_exercised), so I couldn't judge what a first-time user sees when automatic retrieval fails (the KF-9 precondition failures).
The statemap does not record Run from the expanded panel with both sides Automated. findings-log says it is runnable, but the resulting status wording was not observed.
The statemap never exercised switching accounts in the reverse direction (manual to clearing) or with files present. I covered this with my own Playwright probe (UX-1), not with statemap evidence.
